senses.gloss: (cmp. חֲפַס) to scrape, rub, esp. to cleanse one’s head, rub, comb.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 31a:1">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>והיה הלל חוֹפֵף וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>והלל חפף</he>) and Hillel was washing his head.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 6:3">Naz. VI, 3</cite> <he>נזיר חופף וכ׳</he> a Nazir may wash (rub with his hand) his hair.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 6:3">Ib.</cite> <he>לא יָחוֹף באדמה</he> he must not use an earth, v. <cite ref="N01345"><he>נָשַׁר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 150:1">Yalk. Gen. 150</cite> (play on <he>חפים</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 46:21">Gen. XLVI, 21</cite>) <he>לא חָפַפְתִּי וכ׳</he> I did not wash (my head) or comb.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:4">Tosef. Ter. X, 4</cite> <he>שחִיפָּת וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. which a priest’s daughter has used for washing her hair; <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:4">ib.</cite>
